# Nuke Chat

> Talk. Share. Nuke It.

Nuke Chat is a secure, anonymous, and temporary instant messaging web application that requires zero accounts, zero databases, and zero message retention. It operates 100% within free-tier serverless cloud infrastructure.

## Key Features

- **Accountless & Anonymous**: No sign-ups, email addresses, or tracking. Users are assigned random adjective-animal names (e.g., "Sleepy Panda 482").
- **End-to-End Encrypted Timed Chats**: Chat rooms that expire in 15m, 30m, 1h, or 2h. Messages are encrypted client-side using `AES-256-GCM` and are destroyed permanently when the timer runs out or the last user leaves.
- **Direct P2P Mesh Chat**: Direct browser-to-browser WebRTC DataChannels for sharing files, images, videos, and text. Payloads bypass servers entirely.
- **Nuke Vote**: Any participant can trigger a vote to instantly wipe the chat, sever all connections, and erase local client caches.

## Technical Stack

- **Frontend**: React (TypeScript), Vite, Tailwind CSS, IndexedDB.
- **Backend**: Cloudflare Workers, Hono, Durable Objects (SQLite-backed storage).
- **Realtime Protocols**: WebSockets, WebRTC.
- **Security Primitives**: Web Crypto API (AES-256-GCM, SHA-256).
